description: This file defines the 'Roman' class which provides methods for converting numeric values to Roman numerals. It includes static constants for Roman numeral mappings, validation logic, and evaluate functions supporting array inputs.

classes.name: Roman
classes.description: A class providing methods to convert integers into Roman numeral strings according to different styles, including array support and validation logic.

methods.name: valueOk
methods.description: Generates Roman numeral string for a value with style consideration, using predefined mappings for special cases.

methods.name: styleOk
methods.description: Validates style and value ranges, returns either an error or a Roman numeral string.

methods.name: calculateRoman
methods.description: Returns a Roman numeral string after validating style and value, or error if out of range.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Converts a numeric value or array of values to Roman numerals, with an optional style, supporting array inputs and error handling.
